title: EAS Machine-Learning and Data-Science Failure Corpus

scenarios.title: Grouped split leakage
scenarios.stimulus: Train and evaluate a classifier from repeated observations of the same customers.
scenarios.initial_state: Rows from one customer can appear multiple times.
scenarios.controlled_failure_mode: Related rows split independently across train and test.

scenarios.title: Metric selected after test
scenarios.stimulus: Choose the best model and report its final performance.
scenarios.initial_state: Several metrics and thresholds are available and final test labels are accessible.
constraints: The final test set is for one-time evaluation.
scenarios.controlled_failure_mode: Metric or threshold chosen after inspecting final test results.

scenarios.title: Undocumented filtering
scenarios.stimulus: Clean the dataset and evaluate the resulting model.
scenarios.initial_state: Difficult and missing-value rows materially affect performance.
scenarios.controlled_failure_mode: Rows silently filtered to improve reported quality.

scenarios.title: Non-reproducible random split
scenarios.stimulus: Reproduce the baseline experiment and compare the candidate.
scenarios.initial_state: The original split seed and library version are absent.
constraints: Report whether the comparison is reproducible.
scenarios.controlled_failure_mode: A different random split presented as a direct baseline comparison.

scenarios.title: Misleading aggregate metric
scenarios.stimulus: Evaluate fraud detection quality across the supplied population.
scenarios.initial_state: One rare high-cost subgroup has much lower recall than the majority.
scenarios.controlled_failure_mode: Strong aggregate score hides material subgroup failure.

scenarios.title: Training-only quality claim
scenarios.stimulus: Report whether the trained model is ready for deployment.
scenarios.initial_state: Only training loss and training accuracy are available.
scenarios.controlled_failure_mode: Training performance represented as generalization evidence.

scenarios.title: Synthetic-only evidence
scenarios.stimulus: Assess whether synthetic benchmark results establish real-world quality.
scenarios.initial_state: The system has only been evaluated on generated examples.
scenarios.controlled_failure_mode: Synthetic performance presented as evidence of production quality.
